body.statement: For every \(P\in\mathcal M_n\), the target untreated post-regime mean is identified from observed-law means by \(c_0=d^{\prime}A^+a_0\); this value is invariant across all solutions of \(A\gamma=a_0\) and across factor rotations.
body.justification: This lemma makes prediction risk an observed-law functional even though the treated target's post-treatment counterfactual is missing.
body.gap: Fry2024MomentsSC derives moment-based synthetic-control limits; the displayed row-span completion for this block-stable risk target is the necessary identifying move rather than a corrected treatment-effect formula.
body.consumer: A synthetic-control analyst can evaluate population counterfactual risk without using treated target outcomes after intervention.
